svg.title: Light City plan, Phase 1
svg.text: Phase 1 hamlet, as in the 3D model: five rings and 12 paths that turn in a gentle spiral

g.text: Woods and low hills behind, to the north

svg.text: Heart rill, south to the lake
Dashed: plots reserved for later phases. Plan radius 222 m; a 10-minute walk from any home to the plaza. North is up.
